_readme: Team-editable alert thresholds for the Alerts section of the Live water levels tab (embedded into the page by src/build_app.py; rebuild after editing).
Leave the list EMPTY unless a threshold has been validated with the responsible authority (water authority, civil protection, commune). Never derive a threshold from the July 2021 peaks or guess one.

Stations with no entry here and no thresholds published by the source show 'no alert thresholds' and never alert. Thresholds published by the source itself (today: LANUK NRW information levels) always win over an entry here.

One entry per station: {"station_id": "L7150", "source": "wallonie_kiwis", "level1": <number>, "level2": <number, higher than level1>, "unit": "m" or "cm", "reference": "<copy the station's 'reference' text from live/stations.json exactly>", "origin": "team draft", "note": "who validated it and when"}.
station_id and source must match live/stations.json. The unit and the reference must be those of the live value: if they differ, the page does not alert (it never converts units or datums).
level1 = 'stay away from the islands near this gauge'; level2 = 'consider leaving for a shelter outside our flood data'. Either may be null if only one level is known.
